verdict.rationale: The evidence covers pre-commit and pre-receive hooks, a `--fail` exit flag, scanning GitHub as a source, and routing findings to Slack, Jira, email or webhooks. None of it documents findings surfaced as pull-request comments or status checks in GitHub or GitLab. Local hooks and alert routing are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see scan findings surfaced as pull-request comments or checks in GitHub or GitLab
